description: Bucket vectors (salt + device_id -> bucket) and evaluation vectors (compiled rules + subject -> outcome). evaluate: for every key in expected, evaluate per design §3.2 restricted to subject.namespaces (a key outside them is 'unknown'). Values were produced by the Rust evaluator (services/super-console-main/src/modules/experiment/eval.rs) and cross-checked with an independent Python hashlib implementation.

evaluate.name: traffic: layer bucket outside a 10% range
range endpoints: layer bucket 2593 is in [2593,2594) and not in [0,2593)
weight boundary: run bucket 4304 == first weight -> second variant
paused: paused wins over an override hit (step 3 before step 5)
no_subject: empty device_id on a running experiment; paused still reports paused
override: beats audience and traffic; stale variant key is ignored
audience: operators, app_version boundaries, missing / empty attributes
audience: non-numeric app_version segment makes every version condition false
unknown: key absent, and key outside the requested namespaces
namespaces: requesting both namespaces sees both
rollout: rolled_out returns the winner even without a device_id
anti-example: layer salt == run salt, 10% traffic -> every participant lands in the first variant (why salts must differ)
